about_legalese: © 2026 PureLive open-source project. This is a purely local client that calls the public interfaces of live platforms directly; the project itself does not store, produce or distribute any audio or video. The developer does not collect, process or keep any personal information: all settings and data stay on your own devices, under your control. Users are responsible for how they use this program.

audience_acfun_detail: Shows viewers now; likes and followers are kept apart. Streamer search has no viewer count.
audience_bilibili_detail: The number in lists and rooms is popularity, not viewers now; “watched” is everyone who watched this stream, shown apart.
audience_cc_detail: NetEase CC has two figures, heat and viewers now; they are kept and ranked apart.
audience_douyin_detail: Recommendations, search and rooms show viewers now first; total views show apart.
audience_douyu_detail: The public list's number is treated as heat, not as a head count.
audience_huya_detail: The numbers in lists, details and rooms are all heat; Huya publishes no viewers-now count.
audience_inke_detail: Public lists and details have no reliable viewer count; none is shown.
audience_kick_detail: Lists, search and rooms show viewers now; hidden when the streamer turns the count off.
audience_kilakila_detail: The platform's view number has no clear meaning, so it is left out of the viewers-now ranking.
audience_looklive_detail: The website's recommendations give viewers now; heat is kept apart. A room without a figure shows none.
audience_metric_fallback_desc: Concurrent mode uses only explicit concurrent values. Supported platforms show Pending until data arrives; other platforms retain Heat or Total labels.
audience_metric_settings_desc: Choose platform heat or real concurrent viewers and manage supported platforms separately
audience_missevan_detail: The public score is platform heat; there is no viewers-now count.
audience_mode_heat_desc: Use each platform list’s heat or cumulative-view field; these values are not concurrent viewers
audience_mode_online_desc: Rank by concurrent viewers only for enabled rooms with an explicit value; other rooms retain their source metric label
audience_niconico_detail: Shows total views of the programme, not viewers now.
audience_picarto_detail: Viewers now and total views show apart.
audience_ranking_rule_desc: Ranking order: explicit concurrent counts first, supported rooms awaiting data next, then heat or cumulative metrics. Equal values use stable platform and room IDs to prevent refresh reshuffling.
audience_soop_detail: Recommendations and search show viewers now on PC and mobile together; categories use the one figure they have; a room without a figure shows none rather than 0.
audience_source_not_exposed: Source: public platform data has no concurrent count
audience_source_room_realtime: Source: realtime message after entering a room
audience_twitcasting_detail: The public list gives viewers now; a room without it does not show total views instead.
audience_twitch_detail: Lists, search and rooms show viewers now.
audience_weibo_detail: Public lists and rooms have no reliable viewer count; none is shown.
audience_xiaohongshu_detail: Share data may carry a display text for viewers, but it is not a reliable count and is not used.
audience_yy_detail: The public figure is platform heat; the website has no separate viewers-now count.

danmaku_block_long_desc: Danmaku longer than {count} characters are not shown (an emoticon counts as one)

danmaku_long_press_action: Long-press an on-screen danmaku for block actions
danmaku_masked_blocks_cleaned: Removed {count} blocked masked names (they also hid other viewers)
danmaku_max_visible_desc: How many danmaku fly over the picture at once (48 by default); fewer is clearer and saves power
danmaku_paused_behavior_desc: Whether danmaku stop with a paused video or keep flying
danmaku_show_gifts_desc: Valuable gifts fly over the picture, precious ones stay at the top for 4 s; a combo flies at its start and with its total, at most 3 a second
danmaku_similarity_cache_duration_desc: Identical or similar messages will not be displayed again during this period
danmaku_similarity_filter_desc: Automatically filters highly similar danmaku messages within a short period
danmaku_similarity_max_cache_size_desc: Limits the memory used by the similarity cache
danmaku_tap_action: Tap an on-screen danmaku for actions

danmaku_template_dense_desc: Danmaku use the top 55% of the picture with smaller, faster text, so busy rooms still show them all.

douyu_cookie_expired_refreshable: Session expired at {time}; saved, and the next playback renews it with LTP0

douyu_cookie_refresh_no_credentials: Renewing needs LTP0 and dy_did: fill the two fields below
douyu_cookie_refresh_no_session: This cookie carries no session (dy_auth / acf_jwt_token), so there is nothing to renew
douyu_cookie_refresh_ok: Renewed: the new cookie is saved and in use (valid until about {time})

douyu_cookie_valid_no_expiry: Signed in (the cookie carries no end time; add LTP0 to renew it automatically)

douyu_ltp0_hint: the LTP0 in the passport.douyu.com request cookie; filled automatically when you paste above
douyu_session_needs_cookie: Session is no longer valid; tap to paste a new cookie
douyu_session_renewable: Session expired; renewed automatically on playback
douyu_suspected_automated_filter_desc: Turn on to hide suspected automated or event chat heuristically; ordinary chat may also be hidden

webdav_help_intro_body:
Jianguoyun supports WebDAV access for backup and file management. This guide uses a personal Jianguoyun account as an example.
Free plan: 1 GB uploads/month and 3 GB downloads/month. Storage grows with uploaded data. Plans can change; check the official pages before relying on a quota.
webdav_help_issue_browser_a: A WebDAV endpoint is intended for a WebDAV client and may show an authentication prompt or an error in a normal browser. Verify it inside Pure Live.
webdav_help_issue_browser_q: 2. The address looks different in a browser
webdav_help_issue_credentials_a: Check the account email and use the dedicated app password. Regenerate the app password if it was revoked.
webdav_help_issue_revoke_a: Delete the matching entry in Third-party app management, generate a new app password, and update the Pure Live configuration.
webdav_help_issue_revoke_q: 5. Revoke access or reset a password
webdav_help_issue_timeout_a: Recheck the complete HTTPS directory URL and current network or proxy route, then retry from the inline error action.
webdav_help_issue_upload_a: Check the account quota, directory write access, available network connection, and whether the remote file still exists.
webdav_help_limits_body: Jianguoyun's official WebDAV help currently lists a default 500 MB upload limit, up to 600 requests per 30 minutes for free accounts (1,500 for paid accounts), and up to 750 entries per directory response. Provider rules can change; consult the official help page for the latest limits.
